input.summary: Add a numbered § 10.5 perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense Developed Software, and conform § 17.2.
input.comment: [Playbook] Section 10.4 vests in M&I every work of authorship "even if paid for by Customer" and § 17.2 limits us to Term-only use, so we have no lasting rights in custom work we fund. Consistent with our fallback position we leave M&I's ownership of its programs and know-how intact but add a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence in new Section 10.5 to use, modify and sublicense the Developed Software for our business, and conform § 17.2 to that licence.

ops.text: 10.5 License to Developed Software. M&I grants Customer a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free license to use, modify and sublicense the Developed Software for Customer's business.

ops.oldText: Customer acknowledges that it has no rights in any software, systems, documentation, guidelines, procedures and similar related materials or any modifications thereof provided by M&I, except with respect to Customer's use of the same during the Term to process its data.
ops.newText: Except as provided in Section 10.5, Customer acknowledges that it has no rights in any software, systems, documentation, guidelines, procedures and similar related materials or any modifications thereof provided by M&I, except with respect to Customer's use of the same during the Term to process its data.
